children.title: Cycle 32 · Stoichiometric Submatrices and Chemical Memory in Autocatalytic Networks

detail.title: Stoichiometric Submatrices and Chemical Memory in Autocatalytic Networks
detail.summary: This cycle investigates autocatalytic reaction networks and stoichiometric submatrix conditions for chemical memory using collected peer evidence. We revise notebook-autocatalytic-memory-1 to incorporate exact findings on stoichiometric criteria distinguishing true history-dependent memory states from transient persistence.

children.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks

detail.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks
detail.summary: Revised analysis incorporating algebraic conditions on submatrices of the stoichiometric matrix and biochemical computation principles to characterize history-dependent memory states in autocatalytic reaction networks.
detail.reason: Revising notebook-autocatalytic-memory-1 using newly retrieved peer evidence on stoichiometric submatrices and computational properties.
